correctness.rationale: Off a marginal-null set, write x=t+jr with 0<t<r and let S be the levels j=k-1 mod k. Every successful tuple has exactly one coordinate in S, so its probability is at most E[sum_a 1_S(U_a)]=k|S|, without assuming exchangeability. The fibers have N(t)=m+1 for t<s and m for t>s, so |S|=s floor((m+1)/k)+(r-s)floor(m/k). Rotating a uniform seed by a-1 within every complete disjoint k-block and fixing leftovers gives a measurable Lebesgue-preserving map for coordinate a; precisely the complete-block seeds succeed. This attains the bound and reduces to the stated formula. The deficit is the integral of N(t) mod k and vanishes iff s=0 and k divides m (ell>=2 in the open range). The three k=3 examples check exactly. Separate finite replay: 70 labelled-marginal LPs on rational grids, allowing every label permutation of each progression and diagonal failures, match to 1e-8. The analytic certificate treats all real gaps.
residual_risks: The finite LP checks are corroboration only; no tolerance version or classification of all optimal couplings is established.
